title: Go-live toolkit for secure private deployments: feature enablement, release choreography, and customer launch kit
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Prepare a comprehensive go-live toolkit to coordinate release notes, cross-team launch tasks, enablement materials, and customer onboarding for the Private/VPC/On‑prem feature set (RBAC, audit logs, KMS integration). Goal is a low-friction enterprise launch that meets compliance needs and reduces support escalation by providing clear runbooks, comms templates, and training for Sales/CS/Support.
scope: In-scope: RBAC (managed roles + API control plane UX), audit log export + retention settings, KMS integration for customer key management, release notes and docs, enablement training, support runbooks, and rollout gating (feature flags + canary policy).
Out-of-scope: On-prem install packaging updates beyond current GA installer, custom KMS connectors for non‑standard HSMs (handled as follow-up), and billing model changes.
milestones: 2025-02-20: Alignment kickoff with Eng, Security, Docs, Sales, Support, Compliance
2025-02-28: Draft release notes + public-facing docs + internal runbooks ready
2025-03-07: Internal beta with 3 pilot customers (security checklist applied)
2025-03-25: Final sign-off on comms and GA date
owners_and_stakeholders: Sales Enablement: Mateo Ruiz (customer enablement kit)
release_notes_plan: Owner: Sofia Marin to produce two artifacts: public release notes (one-pager) and detailed 'what changed' for admins (technical notes)
Timeline: Public draft by 2025-02-28, internal review 48h, final by 2025-03-20
Choreography: Coordinate with Marketing for GA blog post, Security for compliance language, and Console team for UI copy updates
Change log bullets: RBAC roles (new), Audit log exporters (S3/GCS), KMS key-rotation guidance, known limitations and fallback behavior (model fallback on KMS errors)
enablement_and_training: Sales/CS playbook: Two scenario-based guides (greenfield onboarding, migration from hosted to private) with objection-handling and SSO/KMS checklist
Support runbooks: Escalation steps for KMS failures, audit log missing events, and RBAC misconfigurations
Training schedule: 3 live sessions (EMEA/APAC/NA) and recorded video + quiz hosted in internal LMS
Customer-facing assets: Quickstart checklist (PDF), Admin checklist (Confluence), Troubleshooting cheat-sheet
rollout_strategy: Phase 0: Internal dogfooding for 1 week — core teams opt-in
Phase 1: Invite-only pilot (3 customers) with contract addendum and dedicated CS contact
Phase 2: Gradual enablement via feature flag per-account; autopilot fallback to hosted models on KMS error
Phase 3: GA with standard docs, billing, and marketplace entries
operational_and_slo_activities: Identify SLOs for audit log delivery latency and KMS key usage failures
Add tracing hooks and dashboard: per-customer KMS error rate, audit export throughput
Define alert thresholds and on-call playbook for incidents related to private deploy security features
acceptance_criteria: Engineering: RBAC APIs + Console UI merged to release branch and covered by e2e tests
Security: Formal SRR (security review) completed and signed off
Docs: Public release notes + admin guide published on Confluence and referenced from Console
Enablement: Support runbooks published and first training delivered
Pilot: 3 pilot customers onboarded and have completed post-onboarding checklist
Monitoring: Dashboards live and alerts validated in staging
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: KMS integration causes transient failures during key rotation — Mitigation: implement transparent retry + circuit breaker and ensure autopilot fallback
Risk: Customers misconfigure RBAC leading to support load — Mitigation: provide pre-deployment validation script and an RBAC validator in Console
Risk: Audit logs volume causes cost spikes — Mitigation: provide retention-tier guidance and default conservative retention with opt-in longer retention
